summary: Application/authentication JSON parsers share declared-size and real streamed-byte caps, bounded concurrent readers, total read deadlines and caller abort handling. Oversize413, timeout/interruption408, malformed/size mismatch400, concurrent-body pressure429 with Retry-After. A contiguous growing buffer avoids unbounded tiny-chunk metadata, and one outer promise race avoids per-chunk abort handlers.

Default16MiB supports the existing500k policy and2m evidence-text contracts even with JSON Unicode escaping; request buffers are allocated/grown only as needed. The existing multipart10MiB/file and4 upload bounds remain separate and unchanged.

Per-instance token buckets apply direct-socket peer admission before authentication; auth/public categories have stricter peer limits; authenticated requests also share principal limits across peer changes. Forwarded/X-Forwarded-For/CF headers are not trusted. Missing socket identity shares one fallback bucket.

Buckets have fixed maximum cardinality, minute idle expiry, token refill and cleanup; capacity fails closed without evicting active limits. Exact health/readiness paths bypass admission while retaining request diagnostics, so shared API/proxy exhaustion cannot falsify deployment health.

Diagnostics accept fixed enum categories only, aggregate counters/gauges/latency bins without identifiers, errors, raw URLs, goals or evidence. There is no diagnostics HTTP endpoint. Internal snapshots and optional periodic operator logs cover the process; the database run queue explicitly declares last-observation semantics and timestamp.

Shutdown/store close removes rate cleanup timers, clears buckets and stops periodic logs. Bounded parser reads remove signal listeners/deadline timers and release reader/concurrency slots even if source cancellation never resolves.

limitations: Rate buckets and admission concurrency are per app/server instance, not distributed quotas. Direct peers behind an untrusted proxy share the proxy bucket; forwarded identities are deliberately ignored.
Defaults are configurable guardrails, not measured pilot capacity or production throughput claims. No production capacity/time-to-first-artifact baseline was measured.

The shared timeout bounds JSON reading. JSON/schema processing and application work are separately bounded by bytes and existing service policies; this does not claim a universal end-to-end request deadline.
Health/readiness are admission-exempt. Readiness retains its existing bounded shared storage probe.
run.queued is the most recent scheduler-observed queued row count for its connected database, with an observation timestamp; it can be stale and is not a process resource count.
No new HTTP diagnostic endpoint, proxy trust configuration, external telemetry export, full suite, browser run, build, live PostgreSQL, git action, deployment or delegation was used.
